description: This tool is for analyzing Stripe Sigma and Metrics data (e.g. about revenue, charges, products, invoices, subscriptions, disputes, transactions, tax tables, payments etc) and run…

intent.description: The intent of the tool call.

params.description: The parameters for the tool call. Required parameters depend on the intent.

dimensions.description: Used with execute_query_template. One dimension to group by, 'product' or 'price'. Only active_subscribers supports it.

grains.description: Used with execute_query_template. One time grain, 'day' or 'month'. Default is 'month'. No weekly report exists: for weekly results, use 'day' and aggregate by week.

include.description: Used with retrieve_query_run or retrieve_report_run. Results are inline under result.inline by default; pass ["result.file"] to get a downloadable file link instead.

limit.description: Used with retrieve_query_run or retrieve_report_run. Maximum number of inline result rows to return. Defaults to 100, maximum 1000.

metric.description: Used with execute_query_template. The canonical metric name.

page.description: With retrieve_query_run or retrieve_report_run, pass the result.inline.next_page_url value from a previous response to fetch the next page of inline result rows.

query_run_id.description: Used with retrieve_query_run, or retrieve_query_template for a QueryRun an earlier template run returned. The QueryRun ID to retrieve.

report_id.description: Used with retrieve_report_type and create_report_run. The unique identifier of the `Report` object (format report_*).

report_parameters.description: Used with create_report_run. A map of parameter names to values for `Report Run` customization.

report_run_id.description: Used with retrieve_report_run or retrieve_query_template. The unique identifier of the `Report Run` object (format reprun_* or rrun_*, depending on which API created it).

result_options.description: Used with execute_query_run or create_report_run. Optional settings for the generated results.

compression.description: Compression applied to the generated results file. Defaults to none.

search_string.description: Used with stripe_data_search. Keywords to match against the names and descriptions of the available metrics, tables, templates, and reports.

sql.description: Used with execute_query_run. The SQL query to execute (Trino 414).

table_name.description: Used with retrieve_query_table. The table name.

name: stripe.stripe_analytics
